card.name: Fire Princess
card.officialTextSummary: Whenever the controller's team actually gains Life Points, each eligible face-up copy inflicts 500 damage to the opposing team.

behavior.trigger: One trigger per positive LP gain event for each face-up Fire Princess controlled by the gaining team.
behavior.amountScaling: The 500 damage is per eligible copy and per LP gain event, not per 500 LP gained.
behavior.teamRouting: Damage is applied to the opposing team's shared Life Points.
behavior.idempotency: The caller supplies eventId and processedEventIds so a retried event is not applied twice.
behavior.physicalOwnership: UID and physical owner seat are retained for audit; controller team determines effect routing.

limitations: This primitive is not registered in monsterEffects.ts or duelEngineCurrent.ts.
No live Discord server interaction was performed.
Historical first TCG release is verified from the official database; regional OCG/TCG date reconciliation remains separate.
The caller must pass a single complete LP gain event and all current Fire Princess field snapshots.
